column3: Close to the Hebrew; חִצִּי (“my arrow”) is rendered “My wound.”
Close to the Hebrew; “men of heart” is rendered “men of understanding.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the righteous, the mighty one” is rendered “Him who is most just.”
Close to the Hebrew; “does not lift up the faces of princes” is rendered “is not partial to princes.”
Close to the Hebrew; צַלְמָוֶת (“deep darkness”) is rendered “shadow of death.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he does not again appoint [a time] for a man” is rendered “He need not further consider a man.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in place of the wicked” is rendered “as wicked men.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he keeps quiet” is rendered “He gives quietness,” and “who will condemn?” “who then can make trouble?”
Close to the Hebrew; חָנֵף (“godless”) is rendered “the hypocrite.”
